title: Explicit invertible finite and common-field tensor components
statement:
def completedTensorCommonComponent
    (N : ∀ E, CompletedTensorFiniteModel l X R closed models E)
    (P Q : generalAlgebraicallyClosedConstructibleCategory l (PadicAlgCl l) X) :
    closed.tensor.obj ((ordinary l X R).obj P, (ordinary l X R).obj Q) ≅
      (ordinary l X R).obj ((commonStageDerivedTensor l (PadicAlgCl l) X).obj (P, Q))

source.place: BS Definition 3.4.10 and Remark 6.8.15; HRS Proposition 5.2 and Lemma 7.9; the corresponding part of the finite normalized realization argument.

proof.text: On integral representatives, tensor the two integral realization isomorphisms, invert N.ordinary, apply derived scalar extension to tensorQuotientIso, invert the integral realization at the integral tensor, and apply realization to the inverse tensorIntegralObjectIso. Every factor is an isomorphism.

For arbitrary common-stage objects, transport both inputs to their prescribed compositum with isoToStage, use the integral component on the two underlying integral representatives there, apply the existing normalized stageTensor inclusion comparison, and apply common-stage tensor to the inverse input transports. This defines invertible components without choosing a witness of an unproved existence statement.

proof_origin.place: Explicit finite normalized scalar comparisons and the coefficient unit, split from new-sf-adic-completed-tensor-common-lift-tensor-unit.
